main_body: Ladder-back chair seen from the front: a backrest with two slats above a seat, with two legs below
top_band: No real top band. Column x=10 has a 2-row light rail at rows 2-3 (L=157), which is the top edge of the backrest, not a seat. The seat is rows 9-11 (L~126), the same tone family as the front, then a 1-row light edge at row 12.
evidence: The seat is the main horizontal surface and must be seen from above. In the column scan its only candidate rows (9-11, L~126) sit within 25 L of the front-face tone, so they belong to the front face. Row 12 is just a light front-edge line, and legs and shadow follow below it. The slats and backrest are drawn flat and face-on. The 2-row light rail at the top is a rim only. This matches the guide's red 'thin seat' and 'front elevation' cases, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours against 38-40 for the references, and a median of 8 colours per tile against 17-20. Its main wood ramp has about 3 steps (light, mid, dark) against 5-6 in the references. 58% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, and some outline pixels are pure black, giving a partly sticker-like look. The wood has no grain or texture dots. It is thinner and flatter than both references.
